commands.command: there's not much left to do from here. the health is critically low at 2/100, and there don't appear to be any other items or actions available in this location. the only valid commands from the yard seem to be going north (back to the larder), west (to the hall), or possibly examining things, but previous attempts to examine items haven't yielded anything helpful. the character is likely going to perish soon without finding any more food or restorative items.

model_identity_correction.why: The runner built one Backend for a whole grid; Backend fixes the request's model field at construction, so the grid's model tuple selected a filename and a price, never a served model. The filename still spells the request.
